+ 136 item(s) not to report
5 item(s) in the KEV catalogue were ruled out in examples/dispositions.toml.
They are in NO on the rationale recorded below, which is the manufacturer's
own determination and not one art14 made or checked. This is the material a
VEX statement and an audit trail are written from.
- CVE-2022-22965 spring-boot-starter-web@2.5.6
Precondition not met. Spring4Shell requires the application to be
deployed as a WAR on a servlet container running on JDK 9 or later.
gateway ships as an executable jar on the embedded Tomcat and runs on
JDK 8u292; neither the packaging nor the runtime satisfies the
exploit. Verified against the built artefact, not against the build
file, because the two can disagree. Decided 2026-09-11 by the platform
security team.
- CVE-2022-22965 spring-webmvc@5.3.12
Same precondition as spring-boot-starter-web above, recorded
separately because the two are separate components and a VEX consumer
reads them as separate statements. The vulnerable path is
WebDataBinder binding a request parameter onto a POJO whose class
loader is reachable through class.module.classLoader, which the Spring
Boot jar launcher does not expose. No controller in this product binds
to a plain POJO from query parameters. Decided 2026-09-11 by the
platform security team.
- CVE-2022-22965 spring-beans@5.3.12
spring-beans carries the CachedIntrospectionResults code the advisory
names, and it arrives transitively through spring-webmvc. It is ruled
out for the same reason and on the same evidence: the packaging and
JDK preconditions are not met in the shipped artefact. Listed in its
own right so that the inventory and the determination cover the same
set of components. Decided 2026-09-11 by the platform security team.
Not reachable in this configuration. CVE-2021-45046 requires a
non-default PatternLayout using a Context Lookup ($${ctx:...}) or a
Thread Context Map pattern, which is how attacker-controlled data
reaches the lookup a second time. log4j2.xml here uses the default
pattern with no ctx/MDC conversion specifier, and nothing writes to
the Thread Context Map. This is a separate question from
CVE-2021-44228 above and was assessed separately. Decided 2026-09-11
by the platform security team.
- CVE-2025-24813 tomcat-embed-core@9.0.54
Not reachable. The partial-PUT path requires the default servlet to be
running with readonly=false and either file-based session persistence
or a library that deserialises uploaded content. gateway leaves the
default servlet read-only, has no PUT route, and uses Redis-backed
sessions rather than the FileStore. Confirmed against the packaged
conf/web.xml and the session configuration in application.yml. Decided
2026-09-11 by the platform security team.
2 item(s) need a decision. Run again with --brief for the full decision
brief on each: where it sits, what it is, who says it is exploited, and the
one question to answer about this product.
